newsitem.title: USA: Guardian International Q4 net loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Guardian International Q4 net loss widens.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Guardian International Inc said that Everest Security Systems Corp merged with Guardian International Inc, a privately held company, and the merged company changed its name to Guardian International Inc in August 1996. All amounts for fiscal 1996 are of the pre-merger Guardian International for the entire year and include the wholly owned subsidiary acquired from Everest from the date of the merger.
All amounts for fiscal 1995 are strictly of the pre-merger Guardian International.

Net income for the fourth quarter and fiscal 1996 included $120,000 for the non-recurring losses of Specialty Devices Inc, a wholly-owned subsidiary acquired in the merger with Everest, and $20,000 in merger related costs.
